mapper.select: SELECT NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM Users WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId} AS uuid) AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT must_change_password )
SELECT NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM Users u JOIN Roles r ON r.role_id = u.role_id WHERE u.user_id = CAST(#{userId} AS uuid) AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.role_name = 'admin' )
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM strategies WHERE strategy_id = CAST(#{strategyId} AS uuid) AND user_id = CAST(#{userId} AS uuid) AND status = 'ENABLED' )
